method: Reviewed the full retrospective lesson, its historical evidence table, executable record example, and six-step capstone sequence against docs/DATA.md and the current multi-agent cost lesson. Corrected the reintroduced 2.37x claim, added ERR-202, updated the preserved issue-scoped verifier, and ran both offline verifiers. No provider or external network call was made.

observations.trace: The local data ledger retains two historical summary ratios (1.91x and 1.99x), states that run-level requests/responses were not retained, and withdraws the unregistered 2.37x claim. The lesson now matches that boundary; it does not infer trend or reproducible cost. The example executes and labels its counts as a sample, not project health. Current verification: W6 10/10; issue-scoped 5/5. Production build generated 404 pages; Pagefind indexed 404 pages / 15,462 words. Light/dark full-page renders are 1300x7679, article width 792px, viewport/document scroll width 1300px, Mermaid rendered; the sole browser console error is favicon 404.

limitations: Raw historical provider requests/responses, model snapshots, scorer records, and bills were not recovered; neither historical ratio was independently recalculated.
The local source trace for LangChain is version-pinned historical evidence and was not rerun in this pass; it does not establish behavior for current versions.
The lesson remains in-review until the whole-curriculum audit and unresolved source/evidence items are complete.
